description: This file defines the interface PropertySearchFilter used for specifying property-based search filters within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for retrieving the property path and the set of values that the property must match in search queries. The interface is used as a core component for constructing complex search filters and queries.

classes.name: PropertySearchFilter
classes.description: An interface defining filters for property-based search, specifying the property path and the values it must comply with for search filtering within the Ditto framework.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating the specific property to search.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns a collection of JSON values that the property must match to include in the search results.
